comparison.objective: Unmold a tart by lowering its pan ring, versus mechanically seating a collet in a nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Level bimanual ring lowering around a fragile tart; candidate uses marked-point groove capture and tilt-roll snap insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Tart must be free and undamaged with ring released; candidate requires retained collet and nondestructive pull verification. Candidate force threshold is unspecified.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual care does not test the same contact transition or retention mechanism.
